features: Ergonomic design: The ZEB-Groot is a wireless mouse that is easily portable and comfortable for everyday use.
Dual mode: The mouse can provide an immaculate dual connection of 2.4GHz and BT so you can work without interruption.
1600 DPI: The mouse has an advanced optical sensor with 1600 DPI for smooth cursor movements with reliably utmost precision.
USB dongle: The mouse comes with a USB nano-receiver for easy plug-and-play.
3 buttons: This mouse is compactly built with 3 buttons- the right & left click and middle scroll.
Silent operation: Work without the click sounds from the regular mouse and replace it with the ZEB-Groot mouse with a silent operation feature.
Power button: The mouse has a Power button for the ON and OFF functions when in use and otherwise.
2-year warranty: The ZEB-Groot wireless mouse comes with a 2-year warranty period owing to its efficient working.
